verdict.rationale: Supabase's own docs say the CLI runs the entire Supabase stack locally or in CI with `supabase init` / `supabase start`, then connects to a hosted project, and the local stack even serves the MCP endpoint at localhost:54321. Community users corroborate that `supabase start` spins up a Docker instance from migration files and that local setup was easy, though others call local dev and migrations a weakness and report Val Town failing to get it working. Those are DX complaints rather than a documented failure of the capability. Missing for 10: per-service evidence that every component (Auth, Storage, Realtime, Edge Functions) behaves identically locally, and a consistently smooth local migration workflow per community reports.
